name: White turtleneck sweater, V insert (female, worn under the blue blazer)
size_basis: Original flat art. The regulation names the garment (white cotton-polyester or wool-blend turtleneck sweater) but gives no figure or dimensions; 3.9 in neck width and 2.9 in neck height are estimates for the blazer base's V.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: regular white cotton-polyester or wool blend turtleneck sweater may be worn instead of the shirt; the blazer must be worn; no tie or tie tab with it (CAPR 39-1 4.2.3.2.2, 4.2.4.2.2, 4.2.4.3)
